description.description: The same in words, for whoever is building a client.

error.description: Why, as a code a client can tell apart: `language_invalid`, `quote_not_allowed` and so on. Each route lists its own.

reason.description: What lies behind it, where one code has several causes: why a post may not be quoted, for one.

delete.summary: Remove the avatar of a profile

post.description:
Replaces any there was, which is removed from storage. Answers with each size of the new one, at addresses good for a short while.

Who may call it: somebody signed in.

avatar.description: The picture: a JPEG or a PNG, of at most 10 MB.

400.description: `file_required` when no file was sent, `file_unreadable` when it cannot be read as a picture

401.description: no token, or one that has expired

403.description: it cannot have one, or the viewer may not change it

404.description: there is no such profile or post, or the viewer may not see it

413.description: `file_too_large`: more than 10 MB, or too many pixels

415.description: `file_unsupported`: not a JPEG or a PNG

post.summary: Set the avatar of a profile

get.description:
For other servers, which keep the address of a picture for weeks: a redirect to a freshly signed address in storage. Only what anybody may see is answered for; anything else, on a site for members included, is not found, in the same words as what does not exist.

Who may call it: anyone, signed in or not.

parameters.description: The node's UUID, which other servers are given.
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.description: Which size: for an avatar `small`, `medium`, `large` or `square`; for a cover `medium` or `large`.
parameters.name: size

302.description: the picture is at the address in Location

404.description: there is no such picture that anybody may see
